title: Leaderboards + time-trial integrity (ghosts + plausibility floor) (AUTH #026)
summary: Per-route time trials with a ghost replay for the UX and a plausibility floor for integrity (SPEC §3.7, Owner chose plausibility floor): a submitted time is accepted only if it clears the deterministic reachability validator's theoretical minimum for that route (reuse M1-SCEN-05 and the same config/movement.json constants) plus telemetry sanity checks; impossible or anomalous times are rejected. Times are rate-limited and tied to a completed, validated run.

acceptance_tests.test: Submitting a route time records it and shows a ghost; a time below the validator's theoretical minimum for that route is rejected, reusing the M1-SCEN-05 validator and config/movement.json constants (no duplicated numbers).
Telemetry sanity checks reject anomalous runs; times are rate-limited per user and device and tied to a completed, validated run (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §10.3).
A scripted impossible-time submission is rejected in a test.

history.event: created by the Coordinator (M4 decomposition, AUTH #026): Owner chose the plausibility-floor integrity model (full replay verification deferred).
